item.title: Saturday in-person absentee voting for congressional primaries begins this weekend
item.description: Residents planning to submit an absentee ballot ahead of congressional primaries in Mississippi will soon have a couple of weekend opportunities to do so. On Saturday, Feb. 28, and Saturday, March 7, circuit clerk offices statewide will be open from 8 a.m. until noon for in-person absentee voting. Circuit clerk offices will also be open […]

item.title: Tupelo tennis coach named finalist for nation’s top prep coach award
item.description: Payton Pearce, head tennis coach at Tupelo High School, is a finalist to be named the nation’s best prep coach. item.description: A coalition of local elected officials, economic development leaders, and tourism department heads in central Mississippi is celebrating after the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers approved a flood-mitigation plan for the Pearl River, bringing a decades-long initiative closer to the finish line. item.description: Mississippi State University welcomed a special guest from one of the United States’ greatest global allies on Wednesday. British Consul General to the Southeast U.S. Rachel Galloway visited the school’s Starkville campus for a discussion with university President Mark Keenum on leadership and shared U.K.-American cultural and education connections. item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Mississippi State Has a Massive Opportunity in Texas This Weekend
item.description: Mississippi State has cruised to a 9-0 start, but starting today, the price of poker goes up for the Diamond Dawgs. Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk preview the Amegy Bank College Baseball Series, paying extra attention to the opener with Arizona State and the finale with the nation’s #1 team, UCLA.
